Amashusho yo mu bwenge ndi ku gitanda canje be n’ivyo nerekewe mu mutwe, bitangura kuntera ubwoba+. 6 Nuko ntanga itegeko ngo hazanwe imbere yanje inkerebutsi zose z’i Babiloni, kugira ngo zimenyeshe insobanuro y’iyo ndoto+. 7 “Uwo mwanya abaherezi b’abanyamageza, abahamagara imizimu, Abakaludaya+ n’abaragurira ku nyenyeri+ barinjira; hanyuma mvugira imbere yabo nya ndoto, mugabo ntibamenyesha insobanuro yayo+. 8 Amaherezo hinjira Daniyeli, umwe yitwa Beluteshazari+ hisunzwe izina ry’imana yanje+, uwurimwo impwemu ya za mana nyeranda+, aza imbere yanje; maze imbere yiwe nigana nya ndoto, nti: 9 “‘Ewe Beluteshazari umukuru w’abaherezi b’abanyamageza+, kubera ko jewe nzi neza yuko impwemu ya za mana nyeranda iri muri wewe+ be n’uko ata banga na rimwe rigutesha umutwe+, mbwira ivyo neretswe mu ndoto nabonye be n’insobanuro yayo+. 10 “‘Ivyo nerekewe mu mutwe ku gitanda canje rero ndavyitegereza+, maze mbona igiti+ hagati mw’isi c’uburebure amahero+. 11 Ico giti kirakura, kirakomera, uburebure bwaco burahava bushikira amajuru, kandi caraboneka gushika ku mpera y’isi yose+. 12 Amababi yaco yari meza, n’ivyamwa vyaco vyari vyinshi, kandi kuri co hari ibifungurwa vyo guhaza ibiriho vyose. Ibikoko+ vyo mw’ishamba vyaronderera igitutu munsi yaco+, inyoni zo mu kirere na zo zikibera ku mashami yaco+, kandi ikiri n’umubiri cose kikarya ibivuye kuri co. 13 “‘Nabandanije kwitegereza mu vyo nerekewe mu mutwe ku gitanda canje, maze ehe inderetsi+, emwe, umweranda+, imanuka ivuye mu majuru. 14 Yariko asemerera n’ijwi rirenga, avuga ati: “Nimwicire ico giti+, muteme n’amashami yaco. Nimuhungurure amababi yaco, musanzaze ivyamwa vyaco. Ibikoko bihunge bive munsi yaco, n’inyoni zihunge zive mu mashami yaco+. 15 Ariko igishitsi caco mukirekere mw’ivu, kigume kiboheshejwe imigozi y’icuma n’iy’umujumpu, mu vyatsi vyo mw’ishamba; gitoteshwe n’ikime co mu majuru, umugabane waco ube hamwe n’ibikoko mu bimera vyo kw’isi+. 16 Umutima waco nuhindurwe ube uwutandukanye n’uw’abantu, gihabwe umutima w’igikoko+, kandi ibihe indwi+ bigikurakuranirweko. 17 Ivyo ni ibishinzwe n’ingingo y’inderetsi+, kandi ni ibisabwe n’ijambo ry’aberanda, kugira ngo abantu bariho bamenye ko Musumbavyose ari we Mutware mu bwami bw’abantu+, be n’uko abuha uwo ashaka+, agashiraho uwuciye bugufi hanyuma ya bose ngo abuganze+.” 18 “‘Iyo ni yo ndoto jewe Umwami Nebukadinezari nabonye; nawe ga Beluteshazari, vuga insobanuro iyo ari yo, narirya izindi nkerebutsi zose zo mu bwami bwanje zidashoboye kumenyesha insobanuro+. Ariko wewe urabishoboye, kuko impwemu y’imana z’inyeranda iri muri wewe+.’ 19 “Uwo mwanya Daniyeli, uwitwa Beluteshazari+, amara akanya ajorewe, ivyiyumviro vyiwe bitangura kumutera ubwoba+. “Umwami avuga ati: ‘Ewe Beluteshazari, iyo ndoto be n’insobanuro yayo ntibigutere ubwoba+.’ “Beluteshazari arishura, ati: ‘Ewe mukama wanje, iyo ndoto irakarāba abakwanka, insobanuro yayo na yo irabe abarwanizi bawe+. 20 “‘Igiti wabonye, icakuze kigakomera, c’uburebure bwahavuye bushikira amajuru kandi kigashobora kubonwa n’isi yose+, 21 c’amababi meza, c’ivyamwa vyinshi, icariko ibifungurwa bihaza ibiriho vyose, ibikoko vyo mw’ishamba bikibera munsi yaco, n’inyoni zo mu kirere zikibera ku mashami yaco+, 22 ni wewe, mwami+, kuko wakuze ugakomera, ubukuru bwawe bugakura bugashikira amajuru+, ubutware bwawe na bwo bugashika ku mpera y’isi+. 23 “‘Vyongeye, kubera ko umwami yabonye inderetsi, umweranda+, akayibona imanuka ivuye mu majuru, ikaba kandi yariko ivuga ati: “Nimwicire ico giti, mukigeseze. Ariko igishitsi caco mukirekere mw’ivu, mugabo kigume kiboheshejwe imigozi y’icuma n’iy’umujumpu, mu vyatsi vyo mw’ishamba, gitoteshwe n’ikime co mu majuru, kandi umugabane waco ube hamwe n’ibikoko gushika ibihe indwi bigikurakuraniweko+,” 24 iyi ni yo nsobanuro, mwami, kandi ingingo yashinzwe+ ya Musumbavyose+ ni yo izoshika ku mukama wanje umwami+. 25 Uzokwirukanwa mu bantu, ubane n’ibikoko vyo mw’ishamba+, kandi ibimera ni vyo bazoguha ngo urishe nk’amashūri+; uzototeshwa n’ikime co mu majuru, ibihe indwi bigukurakuranirweko+, gushika umenye ko Musumbavyose ari we Mutware mu bwami bw’abantu+, be n’uko abuha uwo ashaka+. 26 “‘Kandi ko vyavuzwe ngo bareke igishitsi c’ico giti+, ubwami bwawe ntuzobura kubusubizwa niwamara kumenya ko amajuru ari yo aganza+. 27 None rero ga mwami, ese impanuro yanje yokubera nziza+, ugakuraho ibicumuro vyawe biciye ku bugororotsi+, n’ububi bwawe mu kugirira imbabazi aboro+. Hari aho ugutunganirwa kwawe kwokwongerezwa igihe+.’” 28 Ivyo vyose bishikira Nebukadinezari umwami+. 29 Haheze amezi* cumi n’abiri, yariko agendagenda hejuru ku kirimba c’umwami c’i Babiloni. 30 Umwami avuga+ ati: “Mbega iyi si Babiloni Ikomeye, iyo ubwanje nubakiye inzu ya cami nkoresheje inkomezi z’ubushobozi bwanje+, nkayubakira kandi iteka ry’ubukuru bwanje+?” 31 Iryo jambo rikiri mu kanwa k’umwami, ijwi ritibuka rivuye mu majuru, riti: “Ewe mwami Nebukadinezari, ubwiwe ngo: ‘Ubwami urabwatswe+, 32 urirukanywe mu bantu, kandi uzobana n’ibikoko vyo mw’ishamba+. Ibimera ni vyo bazoguha ngo urishe nk’amashūri, kandi ibihe indwi bizogukurakuranirwako, gushika umenye ko Musumbavyose ari we Mutware mu bwami bw’abantu, kandi ko abuha uwo ashaka+.’” 33 Ako kanya+, iryo jambo rirangukira kuri Nebukadinezari, yirukanwa mu bantu, atangura kurisha ibimera nk’amashūri, umubiri wiwe utoteshwa n’ikime co mu majuru, gushika umushatsi wiwe ubaye muremure nk’amubi y’inkona, n’inzara ziwe zibaye nk’ivyara vy’inyoni+. 34 “Maze iyo misi iheze+, jewe Nebukadinezari nunamurira amaso yanje mu majuru+, hanyuma ubwenge bwanje butangura kungarukako; ndaheza mpezagira Musumbavyose+, ndashemeza nongera ndaninahaza+ Umwe abaho gushika igihe kitagira urugero, kuko ubutware bwiwe ari ubutware bwo gushika igihe kitagira urugero, n’ubwami bwiwe bukaba ubw’iyaruka ku rindi+. 35 Ababa kw’isi bose babonwa nk’ubusa gusa+, kandi akora uko yigombera mu ngabo zo mu majuru no mu baba kw’isi+. Kandi nta n’umwe ariho yotangira ukuboko kwiwe+, canke yomubwira ngo: ‘Wakoze iki+?’ 36 “Uwo mwanya nyene, ubwenge bwanje butangura kungarukako, kandi ubukuru bwanje n’ubwiza bwanje bitangura kungarukako ku bw’iteka ry’ubwami bwanje+; mbere n’abishikira banje b’i bwami be n’abakomakomeye banje batangura kundondera babishashaye; nsubizwa ku bwami bwanje, nongerwa ubukuru bw’akataraboneka+. 37 “None ubu, jewe Nebukadinezari ndashemeza Umwami w’amajuru+, nkamushira hejuru kandi nkamuninahaza, kubera ko ibikorwa vyiwe vyose ari ukuri, n’inzira ziwe zikaba ari ubutungane+, no kubera ko ashoboye gutetereza abagendera mu bwishime+.”

Ntiyicisha bugufi+ imbere ya Yeremiya+ umuhanuzi+, uwavuze abitegetswe na Yehova. 13 Mbere agarariza Umwami Nebukadinezari+, uwari yaramurahije Imana+; aguma adadaza+ izosi yongera akomantaza+ umutima wiwe kugira ngo ntagaruke kuri Yehova Imana ya Isirayeli. 14 Egome, abakuru bose b’abaherezi+ n’abantu bǎrakora ivy’ubuhemu ku rugero runini, bisunze ibintu biteye ishishi+ vyose vy’amahanga, ku buryo bahumanya inzu ya Yehova, iyo yari yarejeje i Yeruzalemu+. 15 Yehova Imana ya ba sekuruza babo aguma abarungikira imburi biciye ku ntumwa ziwe+, akazirungika incuro n’izindi, kuko yumvira impuhwe abantu biwe+ n’aho aba+. 16 Mugabo baguma bashinyagurira+ izo ntumwa z’Imana y’ukuri, basuzugura amajambo yayo+ bongera batwenga+ abahanuzi bayo, gushika ubushangashirwe+ bwa Yehova buje ku bantu biwe, gushika aho gukira bitaba bigishoboka+. 17 Nuko aduza umwami w’Abakaludaya+ ngo abatere, uno na we atangura kwicisha inkota+ imisore yabo mu nzu y’aheranda habo+, ntiyumvira impuhwe umusore canke umwigeme w’isugi, umutama canke umusaza bukokori+. Imana itanga ikintu cose mu kuboko kwiwe. 18 Kandi ibikoresho vyose+ vyo mu nzu y’Imana y’ukuri, bininibinini+ na bitobito, be n’amatunga+ y’inzu ya Yehova n’amatunga y’umwami+ n’ay’abaganwa biwe, vyose ajana i Babiloni. 19 Atangura guturira inzu y’Imana+ y’ukuri yongera asiturira hasi uruhome+ rwa Yeruzalemu; iminara yaho yo kubamwo yose bayituriza umuriro, be n’ibintu vyaho vyose bihimbaye+, kugira bahayogeze+. 20 Vyongeye, abasigaye batishwe n’inkota abatwara i Babiloni ari imbohe+, baba abasuku biwe+ n’ab’abahungu biwe gushika ubwami bw’Ubuperesi+ butanguye kuganza; 21 kugira ngo ashitse ijambo rya Yehova ryavuzwe n’akanwa ka Yeremiya+, gushika igihugu cishuye amasabato yaco+. Ivyo dusoma mu gitabu ca mbere ca Samuweli (16, 1-13)
Muri irya misi, Umukama yabwiye Samuweli ati: «Ubwo uzoreka kuririra Sawuli ryari kandi ari jewe namwikuriye ku ngoma y’Israyeli? Niwuzuze ako gakunga, uheze uve hasi ugende, ndakurungitse kwa Yese w’i Betelehemu; mu bahungu biwe, ni ho natoye umwami.» Samuweli aramusiguza ati: «Nogenda nte? Erega, Sawuli niyavyumva, azonyica!» Umukama aramwishura ati: «Jana inka y’ishashi, ugende, uvuge uti: Nje gushikanira Umukama imbagwa. Uheze utumire Yese, nanje nzokwereka uko uzogenza; uzonsīgira uwo nzokurangira.»
Samuweli rero arakora ivyo Umukama yamubwiye. Ashitse i Betelehemu, abakuru b’igisagara baza kumusanganira, bahinda agashitsi. Baramubaza bati: «Mbega, ugenzwa n’amahoro? Na we ati: «Egome, gire amahoro: nazanywe n’ugushikanira Umukama imbagwa. Nimwityorore rero, muze kwifatanya nanje mu guhereza iyi mbagwa.» Samuweli aratyorora Yese n’abahungu biwe, araheza arabatumira kuri iyo mbagwa.
Babaye bagishika, Samuweli akubita ijisho Eliyabu, umwe mu bahungu ba Yese, aca yibwira ati: «Nta gukeka, uyo ni we Umukama yatoye.» Ariko, Umukama aca abwira Samuweli ati: «Ntushime igihagararo canke uburebure, uwo si we natoye. Ivyiyumviro vy’Imana ntibisa n’ivy’abantu: abantu baraba ibiboneka, na yo Imana ikaraba umutima.»
Hanyuma, Yese acisha imbere ya Samuweli Abinadabu Samuweli aravuga ati: «Uwo kandi si we Umukama yatoye.» Yese amucisha imbere Shama; naho nyene, Samuweli avuga ati: «Eka n’uwo si we Umukama yatoye.» Hanyuma, Yese acisha imbere ya Samuweli abahungu biwe indwi, ariko na we aza aramuhakanira ati: «Nta n’umwe Umukama yatoye muri abo.» Ni ko kubaza Yese ati: «Ubwo, abahungu ufise ni abo gusa?» Na we aramwishura ati: «Haracasigaye murumunawabo ari kuragira.» Samuweli amutumako Yese ati: «Rungika uwuja kumuzana, kuko tudakora ku munwa adashitse ngaha.» Yese rero arungika uwugenda kumuzana.
Uwo muhungu yari afise imishatsi y’inkugutu n’ijisho rikerebutse, eka yaraboneka ko abangutse. Umukama rero ati: «Ni uwo, musige amavuta.» Samuweli afata nya gakunga karimwo amavuta, aramusiga akikijwe na bakurube. Umutima w’Umukama uca umwururukirako kuva uwo musi.

Ivyo dusoma mu Nkuru nziza ya Yezu Kristu nk’uko yashikirijwe na Mariko (2, 23-28)
Umusi umwe, hari kw’isabato, Yezu aca mu mirima y’ingano, abigishwa biwe na bo habita baraha udushishi twazo. Abafarizayo rero bamubarira bati: «Ehe raba! Ni kuki bakora ikizira ku musi w’isabato?» Yezu na we abishura ati: «Ntimwigeze musoma ivyo Dawudi yakoze igihe yari yaburaniwe, ashonje, we n’abo bari kumwe? Yarinjiye mu ngoro y’Imana, hari mu gihe c’umuherezankuka mukuru Abiyatari, arya imikate y’imperezwa kandi abaherezankuka ari bo basa bashobora kuyirya, arongera ayigaburira abagenzi biwe.» Hanyuma ati: «Isabato yagiriwe abantu, abantu si bo baremewe isabato. Ni co gituma Umwana w’umuntu aganza n’isabato nyene.»

8 Nayo Sauli, yari ashigikiye iyicwa ryiwe+. Kuri uwo musi havyuka uruhamo rukomeye+ kw’ishengero ryari i Yeruzalemu; bose kiretse intumwa barasanzara+ mu ntara za Yudaya na Samariya. 2 Mugabo abagabo batinya Imana bajana Sitefano kumuhamba+, baramuririra cane+. 3 Ariko Sauli atangura gutikiza ishengero. Yitera mu nzu no mu yindi, aburutira hanze abagabo n’abagore, akabatwara mw’ibohero+. 4 Ariko abari basanzajwe, baca mu gihugu bamenyesha inkuru nziza y’ijambo ry’Imana+. 5 Filipo we, amanuka mu gisagara ca Samariya+, atangura kwamamaza Kristu kuri bo. 6 Amasinzi, ahuje inama, yariko aratega yompi ibivugwa na Filipo, bumviriza bongera baraba ibimenyetso yariko arakora. 7 Kuko benshi barimwo impwemu zihumanye+, zino zigasemerera n’ijwi rirenga maze zigasohoka. Vyongeye, abantu benshi bamugaye+ n’abacumbagira barakizwa. 8 Nuko haba akanyamuneza kenshi muri ico gisagara+. 9 Ico gihe muri ico gisagara hariho umugabo umwe yitwa Simoni, imbere yaho akaba yagira ivy’amageza+ akumiza ihanga rya Samariya, akavuga yuko we ubwiwe yari umuntu ahambaye+. 10 Kandi bose, kuva ku muto wo hanyuma y’abandi gushika ku wuhambaye kuruta abandi, baramutega yompi bakavuga bati: “Uyu muntu ni Ububasha bw’Imana, ubushobora kwitwa Ubuhambaye.” 11 Baramutega yompi rero kubera ko yari amaze igihe kitari gito abumiza n’amageza yiwe. 12 Mugabo aho bemereye ivyo Filipo avuga, uno akaba yariko amenyesha inkuru nziza y’ubwami bw’Imana+ be n’iy’izina rya Yezu Kristu, barabatizwa, abagabo n’abagore+. 13 Na Simoni ubwiwe acika uwemera, kandi amaze kubatizwa yamana na Filipo+; kandi yarumizwa no kubona ibimenyetso n’ibikorwa vy’ububasha bikomeye vyaba. 14 Aho intumwa i Yeruzalemu zumviye yuko Samariya yemeye ijambo ry’Imana+, zituma Petero na Yohani kuri bo; 15 bano na bo baramanuka barabasengera ngo baronke impwemu nyeranda+. 16 Kuko muri bo ata we impwemu yari bwazeko, mugabo bari babatijwe gusa mw’izina ry’Umukama Yezu+. 17 Maze babarambikako ibiganza+, hanyuma batangura kuronka impwemu nyeranda. 18 Maze aho Simoni aboneye yuko abo intumwa zirambitseko ibiganza baronka impwemu, agomba kuziha amahera+, 19 avuga ati: “Nimumpe nanje ubwo bubasha, kugira ngo umuntu wese ndambitseko ibiganza aronke impwemu nyeranda.” 20 Mugabo Petero amubwira ati: “Amafeza yawe aragapfana nawe, kubera ko wiyumviriye kuronka ingabirano ya gusa y’Imana biciye ku mahera+. 21 Nta n’akagabane canke agahimba ufise muri ibi bintu, kuko umutima wawe utagororotse imbere y’Imana+. 22 Niwigaye ubwo bubi bwawe rero, kandi utakambire Yehova+ kugira ngo, nimba bishoboka, ubabarirwe uwo mugambi mubi wo mu mutima wawe; 23 kuko ndabona yuko wewe uri indurwe y’ubumara+ n’imbohe* y’ibitagororotse+.” 24 Simoni yishura ati: “Nimuntakambire kuri Yehova mwebwe+, ntihagire na kimwe mu vyo muvuze kinzako.” 25 Nuko rero, bamaze gushinga intahe bimwe binogangije no kuvuga ijambo rya Yehova, basubira i Yeruzalemu, bamenyesha inkuru nziza ibigwati vyinshi vy’Abasamariya+. 26 Ariko umumarayika wa Yehova+ avugana na Filipo, ati: “Haguruka uje mu bumanuko ku nzira imanuka iva i Yeruzalemu ija i Gaza.” (Iyo ni inzira yo mu bugaragwa.) 27 Kuri ivyo arahaguruka aragenda, maze, ehe inkone*+ y’Umunyetiyopiya+, umuntu w’ububasha yakorera Kanidake umwamikazi w’Abanyetiyopiya, akaba kandi ari we yari ashinzwe itunga ryiwe ryose. Yari yagiye i Yeruzalemu gusenga+, 28 mugabo yari agarutse akaba yari yicaye mu mukogote wiwe, ariko asoma n’ijwi ryumvikana ivyanditswe n’umuhanuzi Yesaya+. 29 Nuko impwemu nyeranda ibwira+ Filipo iti: “Egera ujane n’uyo mukogote.” 30 Filipo arirukanga hambavu, amwumva asoma ivyanditswe na Yesaya umuhanuzi n’ijwi ryumvikana, avuga ati: “Uratahura vy’ukuri ivyo uriko urasoma?” 31 Na we ati: “Mu vy’ukuri, noshobora gute kubitahura hatagize uwundongōra?” Aca yinginga Filipo ngo yurire yicarane na we. 32 Buno igisomwa c’Icanditswe yariko arasoma n’ijwi ryumvikana cari iki: “Nka kurya kw’intama, ni ko yazanywe mw’ibagiro, kandi nka kurya kw’umwagazi w’intama utavuga imbere y’umukemuzi wawo, ni ko adakurako umunwa+. 33 Mu gihe c’uguteterezwa kwiwe urubanza rubereye yararukuweko+. Ni nde azodonda amamuko yiwe*? Kubera ko ubuzima bwiwe bukuwe kw’isi+.” 34 Nya nkone yishura Filipo iti: “Ndakwinginze umbwire: Ibi umuhanuzi abivuga kuri nde? Kuri we nyene canke ku wundi muntu?” 35 Filipo ateranura akanwa+, ahera kuri ico Canditswe+, amumenyesha inkuru nziza yerekeye Yezu. 36 Bariko baragenda muri iyo nzira, bashikira ikidengeri c’amazi, hanyuma nya nkone ivuga iti: “Ehe ikidengeri c’amazi; ni igiki kimbuza kubatizwa+?” 37 * —— 38 Aca ategeka wa mukogote guhagarara, bompi bamanuka mu mazi, Filipo be na nya nkone; araheza arayibatiza. 39 Bamaze kuduga bavuye mu mazi, impwemu ya Yehova itwara Filipo ningoga+, nya nkone na yo ntiyaba ikimubona, kuko yabandanije urugendo inezerewe. 40 Mugabo Filipo aboneka ari i Ashidodi, hanyuma aca muri ako karere aguma amenyesha+ inkuru nziza ibisagara vyose kugeza ashitse i Sezariya+.

14 “Ehe umusi uraje, umusi wa Yehova+, kandi isahu ryawe rizogabanganywa hagati muri wewe. 2 Emwe, nzokoranya amahanga yose kugira atere Yeruzalemu+; ico gisagara kizofatwa ata kabuza+, amazu asahurwe, n’abagore bashurashuzwe ku nguvu+. Kandi ica kabiri c’igisagara kizoja mu bunyagano+; ariko abazosigara mu bantu+ ntibazorandurwa mu gisagara+. 3 “Emwe, Yehova azosohoka arwanye ayo mahanga+ nko ku musi arwana, ku musi w’intambara+. 4 Kuri uwo musi, ibirenge vyiwe bizohagarara ku musozi w’ibiti vy’imyelayo uri imbere ya Yeruzalemu, mu buseruko+; kandi uwo musozi w’ibiti vy’imyelayo+ uzosadukira hagati+, kuva i burasirazuba gushika mu burengero. Hazoba umubande munini cane; igice kimwe c’uwo musozi kizokwikumira kija mu buraruko, ikindi na co cikumire kija mu bumanuko. 5 Muzohungira mu mubande wo hagati y’imisozi yanje+; kuko nya mubande uzoshika i Azeli. Muzohunga koko, nka kumwe mwahunga kubera nyamugigima mu misi ya Uziya umwami wa Yuda+. Yehova Imana yanje azoza koko+, kandi aberanda biwe bose bazoba bari kumwe na we+. 6 “Kuri uwo musi nta muco w’agaciro uzoboneka+—ibintu bizokanya bigumarare+. 7 Kandi uwo musi uzoba vy’ukuri umusi umwe uzwi ko ari uwa Yehova+. Ntihazoba umurango canke ijoro+; ku mugoroba hazoba umuco+. 8 Kuri uwo musi, amazi mazima+ azova i Yeruzalemu+, igice kimwe cayo kije mu kiyaga co mu buseruko+, ikindi na co kije mu kiyaga co mu burengero+. Ivyo bizoba mu ci no mu rushana+. 9 Emwe, Yehova azoba umwami w’isi yose+. Kuri uwo musi, Yehova azoba umwe+, n’izina ryiwe ribe rimwe+. 10 “Igihugu cose kizohindurwa kibe nka Araba+, kuva i Geba+ gushika i Rimoni+ mu bumanuko bwa Yeruzalemu; Yeruzalemu izohaguruka ibemwo abantu, mu kibanza cayo+, kuva kw’Irembo rya Benyamini+ gushika ahari Irembo rya Mbere, gushika kw’Irembo ryo mu Mfuruka, no kuva ku Munara wa Hananeli+ gushika ku bikono vy’umwami baganiramwo. 11 Abantu bazohaba vy’ukuri; kandi ntihazosubira kuba ivy’ukugenera umuntu agatikizo+, kandi Yeruzalemu bazoyibamwo koko mu mutekano+. 12 “Iki ni co kiza Yehova azoteza ibisata vy’abantu bizotera koko Yeruzalemu+: Inyama z’umuntu zizomuborerako ahagaze+; amaso y’umuntu azoborera mu binogo vyayo, ururimi rw’umuntu na rwo ruborere mu kanwa kiwe. 13 “Kuri uwo musi, umuvurungano uvuye kuri Yehova uzokwiragira muri bo+; umwe wese azocakira ukuboko kwa mugenziwe, kandi ukuboko kwiwe kuzorwanya ukuboko kwa mugenziwe. 14 Yuda na yo nyene izorwanira i Yeruzalemu; kandi ubutunzi bw’amahanga yose ahakikije buzokwegeranywa koko: inzahabu n’ifeza n’impuzu, vyinshi rwose+. 15 “Uku ni ko ikiza kizotera ifarasi n’inyumpu n’ingamiya n’indogobwa y’ingabo n’ubwoko bwose bw’igitungwa kiri muri ayo makambi kizomera: kizomera nka nya kiza. 16 “Kandi abasigaye bose mu mahanga yose aza gutera Yeruzalemu+, bazoduga koko ku mwaka ku mwaka+ kwunamira wa Mwami+, Yehova nyen’ingabo+, no guhimbaza umusi mukuru w’insago+. 17 Abo mu miryango+ yo kw’isi bose batazoduga+ i Yeruzalemu kwunamira wa Mwami, Yehova nyen’ingabo, emwe, nta mvura izogwa iwabo+. 18 Kandi umuryango wa Misiri nutaduga ngo winjire koko, na bo nyene nta mvura izogwa iwabo. Hazotera ikiza Yehova ateza amahanga ataduga guhimbaza umusi mukuru w’insago. 19 Ico ni co kizoba igihano c’igicumuro ca Misiri n’igicumuro c’amahanga yose ataduga guhimbaza umusi mukuru w’insago+. 20 “Kuri uwo musi, ku nzogera z’ifarasi hazoba handitsweko+ ngo: ‘Ubweranda ni ubwa Yehova+!’ Kandi inkono z’iminwa minini+ zo mu nzu ya Yehova zizoba koko nk’amabakure+ ari imbere y’igicaniro+. 21 Emwe, inkono yose y’umunwa munini iri i Yeruzalemu no muri Yuda izoba ikintu ceranda ca Yehova nyen’ingabo, kandi abashikana ibimazi bose bazoza bazitore, maze bazitekemwo+. Kuri uwo musi, nta Munyakanani+ azoba akigera mu nzu ya Yehova nyen’ingabo+.”

6 Ku bw’ico, ubu ko twarenganye inyigisho y’intango+ yerekeye Kristu+, dutere tuja imbere tugana ku buhumure+, tutongera gushinga umushinge+, ni ukuvuga ukwigaya ibikorwa bipfuye+, be n’ukwizera Imana+, 2 inyigisho y’ivy’amabatisimu+ be n’ivy’ukurambikwako ibiganza+, izuka ry’abapfuye+ be n’urubanza rw’ibihe bidahera+. 3 Kandi ivyo tuzobikora, nimba koko Imana ibishatse+. 4 Kuko ibi bidashoboka: ku bijanye n’abamurikiwe rimwe rizima+, bagahonja ya ngabirano ya gusa yo mw’ijuru+, bakaba abasangiye impwemu nyeranda+, 5 bagahonja rya jambo+ ryiza ry’Imana n’ububasha bw’igihe* kiriko kiraza+, 6 mugabo bakagwa+, ntibishoboka ko bongera kuvyurwa ngo bigaye+, kuko baba bongeye kwimanikira Umwana w’Imana no kumutetereza ku mugaragaro+. 7 Nk’akarorero, ubutaka bunyoye imvura ibugwako kenshi bugaheza bukazana ibimera bigirira akamaro barya nyene baburimirwa+, na bwo buraheza bukaronka umuhezagiro uva ku Mana. 8 Mugabo iyo bumeze amahwa n’ibitovu, burahebwa, kandi buba buri hafi kuvumwa+; kandi buruhira guturirwa+. 9 Ariko ku biberekeye ga bakundwa, naho tuvuze gutyo, turazi neza ko ivyanyu ari vyiza kuruta be n’uko mufise ibintu bijana ku bukiriro. 10 Kuko Imana atari iyitagororotse ngo yibagire igikorwa canyu n’urukundo mwerekanye ko mufitiye izina ryayo+, kuko mwakoreye aberanda+ kandi mukaba mubandanya kubakorera. 11 Mugabo dushaka ko umwe wese muri mwebwe yerekana ubwira nk’ubwo nyene kugira ngo mushire amazinda rwose+ ku vyerekeye ca cizigiro+ gushika kw’iherezo+, 12 kugira ntimube ibinebwe+, ahubwo mwigane+ abatorana ya mihango biciye ku kwizera n’ukwihangana+. 13 Kuko igihe Imana yaha umuhango wayo Aburahamu+, kubera ko itashobora kurahira uwundi muntu n’umwe ayiruta, yarirahiye+ yo ubwayo, 14 iti: “Emwe, ari ukuguhezagira nzoguhezagira, no kukugwiza nzokugwiza+.” 15 Kandi gutyo inyuma y’aho Aburahamu yerekaniye ukwihangana, yarakomorewe uwo muhango+. 16 Kuko abantu barahira uwubaruta+, kandi indahiro yabo ni yo irangiza impari zose, kuko ari icemeza cemewe kuri bo+. 17 Muri ubwo buryo, igihe Imana yishingira intumbero yo kurushirizaho kwereka ba samuragwa+ b’umuhango ingene inama yayo idahinduka+, yaserukanye indahiro, 18 kugira ngo biciye ku bintu bibiri bidahinduka muri vyo bikaba bidashoboka ko Imana ibesha+, twebwe abahungiye muri bwa buhungiro turonke indemesho ikomeye kugira ducakire ca cizigiro+ twashizwe imbere. 19 Ico cizigiro+ tugifise nk’inanga y’ubwato y’ubuzima, kikaba ari ntakekeranywa n’ikitanyiganyiga, kandi kirinjira imbere muri rya rido+, 20 aho integuza yinjiye ku bwacu+, ari we Yezu, uwabaye umuherezi mukuru mu buryo bwa Melekisedeki ibihe vyose+.

33 “Ariko noneho Yobu we, ndakwinginze, umva amagambo yanjye,Kandi utege amatwi ibyo mvuga byose. 2 Dore ngiye kubumbura umunwa;Akanwa kanjye+ kagiye kuvuga. 3 Amagambo yanjye ndayavugana gukiranuka k’umutima wanjye,+Kandi iminwa yanjye iravuga iby’ubwenge itaryarya.+ 4 Umwuka w’Imana ni wo wandemye,+Kandi umwuka w’Ishoborabyose ni wo wampaye ubuzima.+ 5 Nubishobora unsubize,Utondeke amagambo yawe imbere yanjye, kandi uhagarare ushikamye. 6 Dore ndi kimwe nawe imbere y’Imana y’ukuri;+Nanjye nabumbwe mu ibumba.+ 7 Ntugire icyo utinya muri jye,Kandi amagambo yanjye ntari bukuremerere.+ 8 Gusa numvise ibyo wavuze,Kandi nakomeje kumva amagambo yawe, aho wavuze uti 9 ‘Ndaboneye, nta cyaha mfite;+Sinanduye, kandi nta kosa mfite.+ 10 Dore yabonye uburyo bwo kundwanya,Imfata nk’umwanzi wayo.+ 11 Yashyize ibirenge byanjye mu mbago;+Igenzura intambwe zanjye zose.’+ 12 Reka ngusubize: muri ibyo ntiwavuze ukuri,+Kuko Imana iruta kure umuntu buntu.+ 13 Kuki uyirwanya?+Ese ni ukubera ko amagambo yawe yose itayasubiza?+ 14 Kuko Imana ivuga rimwe,Ikavuga ubugira kabiri,+ nubwo nta wubyitaho; 15 Ivugira mu nzozi,+ mu iyerekwa+ rya nijoro,Igihe abantu baba basinziriye cyane, Basinziririye mu buriri.+ 16 Ni bwo izibura amatwi y’abantu,+Ikabagira inama igashyiraho n’ikashe yayo, 17 Kugira ngo ikebure umuntu areke ibikorwa bye,+Kandi ikure ubwibone+ mu mugabo w’umunyambaraga. 18 Irinda ubugingo bwe ntibugwe mu rwobo,+Ikarinda n’ubuzima bwe ntibuhitanwe n’umwambi.+ 19 Acyahwa n’ububabare yumva ari ku buriri bwe,Agahora aribwa mu magufwa ye. 20 Ubuzima bwe buzinukwa umugati,+N’ubugingo bwe bukazinukwa ibyokurya biryoshye. 21 Umubiri we ushiraho ntiwongere kuboneka,N’amagufwa ye ataragaragaraga agasigara yanamye. 22 Ubugingo bwe bwegera rwa rwobo,+N’ubuzima bwe bukegera abateza urupfu. 23 Ariko iyo abonye intumwa,Umuvugizi umwe mu gihumbi, Yo kumubwira uko yakora ibyo gukiranuka, 24 Iramutonesha ikavuga iti‘Mureke ye kumanuka ngo ajye muri rwa rwobo!+ Nabonye incungu!+ 25 Reka umubiri we ugwe itoto riruta iryo mu busore bwe,+Asubirane imbaraga zo mu minsi y’ubusore bwe.’+ 26 Azinginga Imana kugira ngo imwishimire;+Azareba mu maso hayo arangurura ijwi ry’ibyishimo, Na yo izasubiza umuntu buntu gukiranuka kwayo. 27 Azaririmbira abantu avuge ati‘Nakoze icyaha,+ ngoreka ibyo gukiranuka, Kandi rwose ibyo ntibyari bikwiriye. 28 Yacunguye ubugingo bwanjye kugira ngo butajya muri rwa rwobo,+Kandi ubuzima bwanjye buzabona umucyo.’ 29 Dore ibyo byose Imana ni yo ibikora,Ikabikora incuro ebyiri, ndetse eshatu, ibikorera umugabo w’umunyambaraga, 30 Kugira ngo igarure ubugingo bwe butajya muri rwa rwobo,+Ahubwo amurikirwe n’umucyo w’abazima.+ 31 None rero Yobu, itonde untege amatwi!Uceceke nkomeze mvuge. 32 Niba hari amagambo ushaka kuvuga, unsubize;Vuga, kuko nishimira gukiranuka kwawe. 33 Kandi niba ari nta yo, untege amatwi;+Uceceke, nkwigishe ubwenge.”

ABANTU nka bose barateba bagashikirwa n’ivyago kanaka. Ivyo birashikira n’abantu ubona umengo nta co babuze.
‘Abanyarutsi si bo bene gutsinda isiganwa, n’abanyenkomezi si bo bene gutsinda urugamba, eka n’inkerebutsi si zo zene kugira ibifungurwa, eka n’abazi ubwenge si bo bene kugira ubutunzi, mbere n’abafise ubumenyi si bo bene kugira ubutoni; kuko ibihe be n’ibishika giturumbuka bibashikako bose.’—Umusiguzi 9:11.
Ikibazo rero kihari si ico kumenya nimba uzoshikirwa n’ivyago ahubwo ni ukumenya ingene uzovyifatamwo nivyagushikira. Nk’akarorero:
Wovyifatamwo gute hamwe wobura ivyawe vyose biturutse ku cago c’icaduka?
Wovyifatamwo gute hamwe bogutora indwara ishobora kuguhitana?
Wovyifatamwo gute hamwe wobura uwawe?
Ivyabona vya Yehova, ari na bo basohora iki kinyamakuru, bemera ko Bibiliya ishobora kugufasha kuvyifatamwo neza igihe ushikiwe n’ivyago no kugira icizigiro gifise ishingiro koko. (Abaroma 15:4) Kugira ubitahure, raba uburorero bw’abantu batatu bashikiwe n’ivyago.

Idominika ya 31 yo mu mwaka A
Ng’iri ijambo ry’Umukama Imana y’ingabo:
Jewe ndi Umwami w’abami, izina ryanje ni rurangiranwa mu makungu. None rero baherezankuka, tege amatwi: nimutangamburukira, ngo mwitwararike kuninahaza izina ryanje, – rivumerewe n’Umukama Imana y’ingabo, – nzobavuma, n’imihezagiro yanyu ntibe igifata. Mwarataye inzira nari naberetse, mutako muhubisha benshi kubera inyigisho zanyu, mwarasambuye isezerano rya Levi, – rivumerewe n’Umukama Imana y’ingabo. – Nanje, igihe cose mwanse gukurikiza inyigisho zanje mukagira nkunzi mw’ibanga ryanyu, narabatetereje, ndabagira ubusa, muteterwa n’igihugu cose.
Mbe, twese ntitwamuka ku muvyeyi umwe? Ntitwaremwe twese n’Imana imwe nsa? None ni kuki twankana urunuka, tukonona isezerano rya ba sokuru?
Ivyo dusoma mw’Ikete rya mbere Umutumwa Pawulo yandikiye Abanyatesalonika (2, 7b-9. 13)
Muribuka, bebewacu, ibikorwa n’uburuhe twarimwo: twarabamenyesheje Inkuru nziza y’Imana turiko turakenura ijoro n’umutaga, kugira ntitugore n’umwe muri mwebwe. Natwe, igituma tudahengeshanya gukengurukira Imana, ni uko, mu kwakira Ijambo ry’Imana mwumvise kuri twebwe, mutaryakiriye nk’ijambo ry’abantu, ariko mwaryakiriye nk’uko riri mu vy’ukuri, nk’ijambo ry’Imana; kandi iryo jambo ntirybapfuyeko ubusa mwebwe abemera.
So mufise ni umwe, ni uwo ari mw’ijuru;
Yezu yabariye ishengero n’abigishwa biwe ati: «Abigisha n’Abafarizayo bari mu cicaro ca Musa. Ivyo bababwira vyose rero murabikore, mugireko mubizigame; yamara ntimubigane mu vyo bakora, kuko ico bavuga si co bakora. Bazigira abantu ku mizigo badashobora, na bo badashaka kuyikozako n’urutoke. Ivyo bakora vyose babikora ngo babonwe; ni co gituma bambara mu ruhanga ifilagiteriya, bakagerekako ubuyonga bw’imitamana yabo. Bakunda kwitangira imbere mu batumire, kwicara ku ntebe z’imbere mu masinagoga, kugirwako bwakeye ku mbuga ahabona, n’uko babita abigisha.

11 Nuko Umwami Salomo akunda abagore benshi b’abanyamahangakazi+ hampande y’umukobwa wa Farawo+: Abanyamowabukazi+, Abamonikazi+, Abanyedomukazi+, Abanyasidonikazi+, n’Abahetikazi+, 2 bo mu mahanga Yehova yari yarabwiye bene Isirayeli ku biyerekeye ati: “Ntimuze mwinjire muri bo+, kandi na bo ubwabo ntibaze binjire muri mwebwe; vy’ukuri, bazohengekera umutima wanyu ku gukurikira imana zabo+.” Abo ni bo Salomo yumiyeko+, arabakunda. 3 Agira abagore amajana indwi, abaganwakazi, n’incoreke amajana atatu; buhorobuhoro+, abagore biwe bahengekera umutima wiwe ahandi. 4 Mu gihe c’ubusaza bwa Salomo+, abagore biwe bari barahengekeye+ umutima wiwe ku gukurikira izindi mana+; nuko umutima wiwe ntiwaba uwukwiye+ ku vyerekeye Yehova Imana yiwe, nk’umutima wa Dawidi se wiwe. 5 Maze Salomo atangura gukurikira Ashitoreti+ imanakazi y’Abanyasidoni no gukurikira Milikomu+ ikintu gisesemye c’Abamoni. 6 Salomo atangura gukora ivyari bibi+ mu maso ya Yehova, ntiyakurikira Yehova bimwe bishitse, nka Dawidi se wiwe+. 7 Ico gihe ni ho Salomo yatangura kwubakira ikibanza gikirurutse+ Kemoshi+ ikintu gisesemye+ ca Mowabu ku musozi+ wari imbere+ ya Yeruzalemu, na Moleki ikintu gisesemye ca bene Amoni. 8 Ukwo ni ko yagiriye abagore biwe bose b’abanyamahangakazi+ bafumbishiriza umwotsi w’ibimazi imana zabo bakongera bakazishikanira ibimazi+. 9 Nuko Yehova arurumbira ishavu+ Salomo, kuko umutima wiwe wari warahengamiye kure ya Yehova Imana ya Isirayeli+, uwari yaramubonekeye incuro zibiri+. 10 Kandi ku bijanye n’ico kintu, yari yamutegetse kudakurikira izindi mana+; mugabo ntiyari yaragumije ico Yehova yari yarategetse. 11 Nuko Yehova abwira Salomo ati: “Kubera ko vyakugendeye gutyo, ntugumye isezerano ryanje n’ivyagezwe vyanje nagutegetse, nzogushikura ubwami ata kabuza, ndabuhe koko umusuku wawe+. 12 Ariko sinzobikora mu misi yawe+, kubera Dawidi so wawe+. Nzobushikura mu kuboko kw’umuhungu wawe+. 13 Ariko sinzoshikura ubwami bwose+. Umuryango umwe nzowuha umuhungu wawe, kubera Dawidi umusavyi wanje+ no kubera Yeruzalemu natoye+.” 14 Maze Yehova ahagurukiriza Salomo+ uwo kumurwanya+, ari we Hadadi Umwedomu wo mu ruvyaro rw’umwami. Yari muri Edomu+. 15 Ibi ni vyo vyabaye: igihe Dawidi yagarika Edomu+, hamwe Yowabu umukuru w’ingabo yaduga guhamba abagandaguwe, agerageza kugarika uw’igitsina-gabo wese muri Edomu+. 16 (Kuko Yowabu na Isirayeli yose babaye ng’aho amezi atandatu, gushika aho amariye kurandura uw’igitsina-gabo wese muri Edomu.) 17 Mugabo Hadadi arahunga, ari kumwe n’abagabo b’Abanyedomu bakeyi bo mu basuku ba se wiwe, kugira ngo baje mu Misiri, igihe Hadadi yari agahungu gatoyi. 18 Barahaguruka rero bavuye i Midiyani+, baja i Parani maze bahitana abagabo b’i Parani+ baraheza baja mu Misiri kwa Farawo umwami wa Misiri, uno aca amuha inzu. Amugenera kandi umukate, amuha n’igihugu. 19 Hadadi abandanya kugira ubutoni+ mu maso ya Farawo ku buryo amuha umugore+, mwene wabo n’umugore wiwe, mwene wabo na Tahupenesi umugore w’iteka. 20 Mu nyuma, mwene wabo na Tahupenesi amuvyarira Genubati umuhungu wiwe, maze Tahupenesi amucukiriza+ mu nzu ya Farawo; Genubati abandanya kuba mu nzu ya Farawo, mu bana ba Farawo. 21 Hadadi yumva mu Misiri yuko Dawidi yari yararyamye hamwe na ba sekuruza biwe+ be n’uko Yowabu umukuru w’ingabo yari yarapfuye+. Hadadi abwira rero Farawo ati: “Ndungika+, nje mu gihugu canje bwite.” 22 Mugabo Farawo amubwira ati: “Ukenye iki kuva igihe ubereye kumwe nanje, ku buryo ubu uriko urondera kuja mu gihugu cawe?” Na we avuga ati: “Nta na kimwe; mugabo ubwirizwa kundungika ata kabuza.” 23 Hanyuma Imana imuhagurukiriza uwundi wo kumurwanya+, ari we Rezoni mwene Eliyada, yari yarahunze avuye kwa Hadadezeri+ umwami wa Zoba+, umukama wiwe. 24 Aguma yegeraniriza abagabo ku ruhande rwiwe maze aba umukuru w’akagwi k’abambuzi, igihe Dawidi yica abantu b’i Zoba+. Na we nyene atangura kubangurira ukuboko umwami+. 27 Iki ni co catumye abangurira ukuboko umwami: Salomo ubwiwe yari yarubatse Ikidunduri+. Yari yarazibiye igihengeri c’uruhome rw’Igisagara ca Dawidi se wiwe+. 28 Kandi uwo mugabo Yerobowamu yari umugabo w’intwari kandi w’umunyenkomezi+. abo babiri bari bonyene mu gahinga. 30 Nuko Ahiya afata nya mpuzu nshasha yari kuri we maze ayitaburamwo+ ibipande cumi na babiri+. 31 Hanyuma abwira Yerobowamu ati: “Itorere ibipande cumi; kuko ibi ari vyo Yehova Imana ya Isirayeli avuze: ‘Ehe nshikuye ubwami mu kuboko kwa Salomo, kandi nzoguha ata gukeka imiryango cumi+. 32 Umuryango umwe+ ni wo uzobandanya kuba uwiwe kubera umusavyi wanje Dawidi+ no kubera Yeruzalemu+, igisagara natoye mu miryango ya Isirayeli yose. 33 Ikibitumye ni uko bantaye+, bagatangura kwunamira Ashitoreti+ imanakazi y’Abanyasidoni, Kemoshi+ imana ya Mowabu na Milikomu+ imana ya bene Amoni; kandi ntibagendeye mu nzira zanje mu gukora ibigororotse mu maso yanje no mu kugumya ivyagezwe vyanje n’ingingo z’ubutungane zanje, nka Dawidi se wiwe. 34 Mugabo sinzokura ubwami bwose mu kuboko kwiwe, kuko nzomugira umukuru imisi yose y’ubuzima bwiwe, kubera Dawidi umusavyi wanje natoye+, kuko yagumije amabwirizwa yanje n’ivyagezwe vyanje. 35 Kandi nzokura koko ingoma mu kuboko kw’umuhungu wiwe ndayiguhe, egome imiryango cumi+. 36 Umuhungu wiwe nzomuha umuryango umwe, kugira ngo Dawidi umusavyi wanje abandanye kugira itara imbere yanje i Yeruzalemu+, igisagara nitoreye ngo ndahashire izina ryanje+. 37 Kandi ni wewe nzotora, uganze koko abo umutima wawe uhahamiye bose+, ube ata gukeka umwami wo kuganza Isirayeli. 38 Kandi niwagamburuka ivyo nzogutegeka vyose, ukagendera koko mu nzira zanje ukongera ugakora ibigororotse mu maso yanje mu kugumya ivyagezwe vyanje n’amabwirizwa yanje, nk’uko nyene Dawidi umusavyi wanje yagize+, nzoba rero kumwe nawe+, kandi nzokwubakira inzu iramba, nk’uko nyene nubakiye Dawidi+, kandi nzoguha Isirayeli. 39 Nzotetereza uruvyaro rwa Dawidi kubera ivyo+, mugabo atari imisi yose+.’” 40 Maze Salomo atangura kurondera kwica Yerobowamu+. Nuko Yerobowamu arahaguruka, ahungira+ mu Misiri kwa Shishaki+ umwami wa Misiri, aguma mu Misiri gushika Salomo apfuye. 41 Nayo ibisigaye mu vya Salomo n’ivyo yakoze vyose n’ubukerebutsi bwiwe, none ntivyanditswe mu gitabu c’ivya Salomo? 42 Imisi Salomo yaganje Isirayeli yose i Yeruzalemu yabaye imyaka mirongo ine+. 43 Maze Salomo aryama hamwe na ba sekuruza biwe+, hanyuma ahambwa mu Gisagara ca Dawidi+ se wiwe; Rehobowamu+ umuhungu wiwe atangura kuganza mu kibanza ciwe.

Idominika ya 1 y’Ubushikiro mu mwaka C
Igihe kiregereje c’aho nzorangura ijambo naraganiye umuryango w’Israyeli n’uwa Yuda. Muri iyo misi, nzotera mu nda ya Dawudi akabuto k’ubutungane kazovyagiza ingingo n’ubutungane mu ntara. Muri iyo misi, igisata ca Yuda kizorokoka, Yeruzalemu na yo igume mu mutekano; ng’iri izina bazoyitazira: «Imana-Butungane-bwacu.»
Umukama arêmera abamwubaha,
Twitegurire dute ukuza kw’Umukama?
Umukama n’abagwirize kandi n’abasasagarize urukundo mufitaniye kandi mufitiye bose, nk’urwo tubafitiye na twebwe nyene; maze n’aremeshe imishaha yanyu mu bweranda butagira amahinyu imbere y’Imana Dawe wa twese, gushika umusi Umukama wacu Yezu azoseruka azananye n’aberanda biwe bose.
Mu bisigaye, benewacu, turabinginga tubahanura mu Mukama Yezu: nk’uko mwigishijwe natwe ingene mutegerezwa kwigenza n’ukunezereza Imana, ni ko mwigenza ubu noneho, n’abe ari ko mubirushirizaho. Ni ko, musanzwe muzi ya mabwirizwa twabahaye ku bw’Umukama Yezu uko ameze.
Yezu yabariye abigishwa biwe ati: «Hazoba ibimenyetso mu zuba, mu kwezi no mu nyenyeri; kandi no kw’isi hazoba amaganya menshi mu bihugu, igihe ibiyaga n’inzuzi bizokwasirana; abantu bazokwicwa n’ubwoba n’igihumura, biteze ibizoba kw’isi, kuko n’ubukomezi bw’ijuru buzonyiganyiga. Niho bazobona Umwana w’umuntu aje mu bicu afise inganji nyinshi n’ubuninahazwa bwinshi. Ivyo bintu bitanguye gushika, murame muraramuye umutwe, kuko ubukiriro bwanyu buzoba bwegereje.
Nimwirinde, imishaha yanyu yoye gutimbishwa n’ivy’uguhurahura, n’ivy’ukuborerwa n’ivy’ukwitwararika ubu buzima, wa musi woye kubagwako giturumbuka nk’umutego; kuko ari ko urya musi uzogwa ku bantu bose iyo bava bakagera. Nimwame mugavye rero, musabe imisi yose, kugira ngo mubashe gukira ayo mabi yose aza kuza, mushobore n’uguseruka imbere y’Umwana w’umuntu.»
